verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference under /reference/ and a first-party Postman collection, which gives runnable requests. It also offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema, which a probe retrieved and parsed. However, no evidence shows the reference pages are interactive (try-it console, in-page execution) or that they embed runnable code samples, so runnable use depends on Postman. Missing for 10: documented in-browser try-it/interactive console, runnable code samples within the reference pages, hands-on corroboration of interactive execution.
